title: Podcast discovery app
summary: Find great podcasts tailored to you.
whyItFails: Platform dominance. Spotify and Apple own listeners. Low monetisation. Discovery doesn't pay. Retention. Users stick with default apps.
whatWouldChange: AI-generated clips and highlights for discovery.

attempts.notes: Changed owners three times before SiriusXM closed the app in August 2023.
Closed in favour of YouTube Music.

attempts.outcome: Acquired by Twitter to help build Spaces

reasons.detail: Platform dominance: Spotify and Apple own listeners.
Retention: Users stick with default apps.
